items.en: Choose iteration patterns that remain correct during mutation.

body.en: A mutable ordered container that stores references to objects. A list can grow, shrink, and contain values of different runtime types.
body.vi: A mutable ordered container that stores references to objects. A list can grow, shrink, and contain values of different runtime types.

body.en: Do not remove arbitrary items from the same list you are iterating unless the algorithm is designed around changing indices. Filter into a new list or iterate over a copy.
body.vi: Do not remove arbitrary items from the same list you are iterating unless the algorithm is designed around changing indices. Filter into a new list or iterate over a copy.

summary.en: Use lists as ordered mutable sequences and reason explicitly about aliasing, copying, mutation, and traversal.
summary.vi: Use lists as ordered mutable sequences and reason explicitly about aliasing, copying, mutation, and traversal.
